subject.title: Dashboard: apps layer — full-bleed tabs + widget gallery

question: Should OpenClaw ship the modular dashboard as a bundled, enabled-by-default plugin with a third-party widget gallery and sandboxed full-tab app surface?
rationale: The proposal creates a new core product surface, activation default, persisted-state model, distribution mechanism, and browser security boundary that require explicit maintainer intent even after mechanical fixes.

options.title: Sponsor after foundation repair
options.body: Approve the direction in principle, contingent on canonical persistence, security fixes, clean restacking, dependency authorization, and direct proof.

options.title: Keep the dashboard opt-in
options.body: Allow a narrower experimental plugin but defer default activation and gallery distribution.

options.title: Decline bundled scope
options.body: Do not add the dashboard and third-party widget gallery to bundled core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after foundation repair
recommendation.body: Approve the direction in principle, contingent on canonical persistence, security fixes, clean restacking, dependency authorization, and direct proof.
